items.title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
items.content_text: Conducted as a sort of proof-of-concept project in just four weeks, the work is significant in two ways. It serves as further independent validation of the cryptography that protects massive quantities of the world's communications on platforms like the Signal app, Google Messages, and WhatsApp. And it demonstrates Google DeepMind's formal verification capabilities using a new AI framework called AlphaProof Code. items.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
items.content_text: Meta has introduced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model to date. It's designed for the routine tasks AI agents handle all day: calling tools, handling small coding tasks, routing requests, extracting data, and processing long documents. Meta says Muse Ember delivers more intelligence per dollar at every reasoning level than Claude Haiku 5.5 or GPT-6 Luna. items.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
items.content_text: Hackers are actively exploiting a recently discovered critical vulnerability that allows them to log in to privileged accounts on many Linux systems, multiple researchers are reporting. The vulnerability, tracked under the name *sshole, arises from the interaction between OpenSSH and a code library known as musl. items.title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift
items.content_text: Bytedance Seed introduces Seedream 5.5, a new image generation model built for professional production workflows. items.content_text: After expanding its Edits app to macOS last week, Instagram's next move is launching this Effect Builder that generates custom filters for your Stories posts with AI.
